evidence.quote: Total investments, at fair value (amortized cost of $ 858,951 and $ 874,196, respectively) | 825,525 | 849,354

rationale: The final Schedule of Investments total row reports fair value of $825.525 million and incorporates both the $653.893 million non-controlled/non-affiliated subtotal and the $171.632 million controlled subtotal. It agrees with the balance-sheet investments-at-fair-value line and companyfacts. The total is 95.79% of $861.863 million total assets, leaving a plausible $36.338 million non-investment remainder. Companyfacts captured the complete investment total, not only one schedule.
